scope: Audit fixes only; no new icon artwork or public release

fixes.title: Forced-colors controls
fixes.changes: System Highlight/HighlightText and ButtonFace/ButtonText pairs; remove CanvasText override on selected SVGs. No page-wide forced-color opt-out.

fixes.title: Coordinate-aligned inspection
fixes.status: implemented; tested at both zoom levels and device densities
fixes.changes: Per-icon viewBox grid, native-unit step, reference inset, canvas-center guides, and separate device-aligned native SVG raster proofs. No artwork edits.

fixes.title: Single-source Warning restrictions
fixes.changes: One six-cell size/appearance restriction record; visible labels required for both styles at all native sizes and scaled uses. Docs, inspector, and usage API derive from it. Five geometry-bound exception entries record outline gaps and filled 16/24 punctuation.

fixes.title: Evidence freshness and clean builds
fixes.changes: Shared fingerprints cover source, tests, dependency closure pins, metadata, workflow files, generated outputs, relevant runtime versions, and report payloads. Add/remove/edit inputs invalidate evidence. The clean rebuild occurs in a separate temporary tree.

fixes.title: Strict standalone SVG parser
fixes.status: implemented; negative tests and current matrix passed
fixes.changes: Exact namespace, element structure, per-element attribute allowlists, and attribute values. Reject hidden or recolored overrides, strokes, event handlers, unsupported markup, and directives. Angular-only; not a general SVG sanitizer.
